registered_requirement: Selective ranking improves when low-confidence cases are abstained.

implementation_interpretation.coverage_denominator: all informative within-session policy pairs whose frozen binary outcomes differ
pair_is_ranked_only_if: both episode judgments pass action-following threshold
both episode judgments pass temporal-coherence threshold
both episode judgments pass selective judge-confidence threshold
neither episode has an explicit abstention or critical contradiction
absolute predicted success-probability difference is at least 0.20

reason: The first implementation incorrectly wired the abstention gate to episode binary classification rather than policy ranking. No benchmark labels were joined and no prediction changed before this correction.
